blocks.html:
This method creates a claim. It sends a request to the 
[Create Claim](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#claims\_postclaims) API route.

children.name: type
children.description:
The claim's type. If `refund`, it means the claim's items
are returned and the customer is refunded. If `replace`, it
means the merchant will send new items in place of the returned items.

children.name: order_id
children.description: The ID of the order this claim is created for.

children.name: description
children.description: The claim's description.

children.name: internal_note
children.description: An internal note viewed by admin users only.

children.name: reason_id
children.description: The ID of the associated reason.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the claim.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).
